name: volvo-calc-charger
description: Household PWA pricing Volvo EV charging

scripts.dev:seeded: scripts/emulators.sh 'pnpm seed && NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_EMULATORS=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-volvo NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY=fake-api-key pnpm --filter frontend dev' --only auth,firestore --project demo-volvo
scripts.build: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter backend lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck
